set.pl: Heisel family parcels in sec. 11 T30N R20E, just south of Pound village (1912 Marinette County atlas)
set.t: The Heisel home is the target; its exact site within sec. 11 is still open. The 1906 text says "west of" Pound while the 1912 Heisel parcels lie S/SW of the village, so check the farmsteads on these parcels on the 1938 aerial. Recovery not reported. Access: private: permission.
pinev: Centre of the Heisel parcel cluster in sec. 11 T30N R20E on the 1912 Ogle Marinette County atlas, p. 50 (about 600 m)
Unconfirmed, one source for the story
